tools.name: create_schedule
tools.description: Create a category schedule. Params: category, name optional, fields array optional.

tools.name: get_schedule_data
tools.description: Read schedule cells by name. Read-only.

tools.name: create_floor_plan
tools.description: Create a floor plan on a level. Params: levelId or levelName, name optional.

tools.name: create_3d_view
tools.description: Create an isometric 3D view. Params: name optional.

tools.name: create_section_view
tools.description: Create a section along a line given in millimetres. Params: x1,y1,x2,y2, name optional. Box is fixed at 3000 x 2500 mm.

tools.name: path_of_travel
tools.description: Create path of travel on a floor plan. Params: startX,startY,endX,endY or starts/ends arrays. viewId optional.

tools.name: create_sheet_set
tools.description: Create one sheet per row and place that row's view on it. Dry-run lists the sheets and writes nothing.
